ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast ratio; approximately 85% high-intensity white pixels (ventral lobes) versus 15% low-intensity black pixels (periphery and median column).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous white regions across both lobes. High-contrast black banding along the entire trailing edge and lower peripheral margins. A wide, dark vertical column of pixels at the peduncle-notch interface with irregular mottling extending into the lower-inner lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression; internal pixel angle approximately 65 degrees with a vertical depth roughly 12% of total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with variable pixel-amplitude (peaks and valleys) along the continuous linear boundary, particularly jagged on the lateral segments of each lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Sigmoidal curve fitting; concave trajectory originating from the median notch transitioning to a pronounced convex sweep toward the terminal distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast pixel clusters at distal tips; right tip exhibits dense, three-dimensional textured clusters (barnacle colonizations); left tip shows similar but less dense clusters. Scattered small circular white scars on the dark trailing edge margin.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct vertical black linear pixel disruptions; one prominent line on the upper-left white lobe and several shorter, parallel linear marks on the middle-right white lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible barnacle colonization at both distal tips and multiple unaligned dark linear scratches on the white pigmentation surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Several isolated, small dark circular spots (mottling) distributed across the high-intensity white fields of both the left and right lobes.
